title: Twenty Thousand Leagues Under the Seas
author: Jules Verne
blurb: In 1866 something enormous is sinking ships at sea. A French naturalist, his loyal servant and a hot-headed harpooner join the hunt — and are swept into a voyage around the world beneath the waves.
edition: Project Gutenberg #2488 (F. P. Walter’s complete translation, 1999; two parts of 24 and 23 chapters)
